name: Aether
author: pcppcp
description: Hold a key to choose the note, then tilt forward/back to bend its pitch. Raising the right side reduces volume; shaking adds vibrato. The angle at note-on becomes home. The satellite dish follows tilt and the radio waves follow the note envelope. Stock mono, legato and portamento modes still apply.
credits: Satellite artwork by DAN76/Rackes; from op1r, ported to kennel by Hundekraft
